title: Glowing present with a bow
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Box body -->
  <rect x="20" y="45" width="60" height="45" rx="4" fill="#FF4466"/>
  <!-- Box body shading (lighter edge) -->
  <rect x="20" y="45" width="60" height="6" rx="4" fill="#FF7799"/>
  <!-- Box body left panel lighter -->
  <rect x="20" y="45" width="12" height="45" rx="4" fill="#FF6688"/>
  <!-- Lid -->
  <rect x="16" y="36" width="68" height="14" rx="4" fill="#FF2244"/>
  <!-- Lid top highlight -->
  <rect x="16" y="36" width="68" height="5" rx="4" fill="#FF6688"/>
  <!-- Vertical ribbon on box -->
  <rect x="44" y="45" width="12" height="45" fill="#FFDD00"/>
  <!-- Vertical ribbon on lid -->
  <rect x="44" y="36" width="12" height="14" fill="#FFEE44"/>
  <!-- Horizontal ribbon on lid -->
  <rect x="16" y="40" width="68" height="8" fill="#FFEE44"/>
  <!-- Ribbon shine -->
  <rect x="46" y="41" width="3" height="6" fill="#FFFFAA"/>
  <!-- Bow left loop -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="30" rx="16" ry="12" transform="rotate(-20 38 30)" fill="#FFDD00"/>
  <!-- Bow left loop inner -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="30" rx="10" ry="7" transform="rotate(-20 38 30)" fill="#FFEE55"/>
  <!-- Bow right loop -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="30" rx="16" ry="12" transform="rotate(20 62 30)" fill="#FFDD00"/>
  <!-- Bow right loop inner -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="30" rx="10" ry="7" transform="rotate(20 62 30)" fill="#FFEE55"/>
  <!-- Bow center knot -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="34" r="7" fill="#FFCC00"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="34" r="4" fill="#FFEE66"/>
  <!-- Bow tails -->
  <path d="M44 36 Q36 50 30 56 Q34 50 38 46" fill="#FFDD00"/>
  <path d="M56 36 Q64 50 70 56 Q66 50 62 46" fill="#FFDD00"/>
  <!-- Bow glow effect -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="32" r="22" fill="#FFEE44" opacity="0.15"/>
</svg>
